name: FA_ASSET_KEYWORDS
description: FA_ASSET_KEYWORDS contains valid asset key flexfield segment value combinations. Segment values are stored in the SEGMENT columns.  The SEGMENT columns which are used may not be in any order. The Application Object Library table FND_ID_FLEX_SEGMENTS stores information about which column in this table is used for each segment. .
